title: Mating call of a male Tokay gecko (Gekko gecko)
author: Richard Ling <wikipedia@rling.com>
changes: Tokay gecko (Gekko gecko), a lizard named after its 'to-kay' call. Trimmed to 10.95–11.95 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
